--- INTERPRETATION ---
HTTP response time is not broadcast latency.
A failed HEAD request does not necessarily mean the stream is unavailable.
GET and FFprobe are evaluated independently.
FFprobe timeout does not prove that a stream is dead.
TSDuck and PyAV are additional diagnostics, not replacements for FFprobe.
TShark analyzes traffic visible on the selected local interface only.
Packet loss and jitter are not reported unless valid RTP statistics are available.
True live-edge latency requires an independent reference timestamp.
